title: acorn: locate why const redeclarations are not detected
prompt: In this copy of the acorn JavaScript parser, redeclaration errors are missing for `const`: `const a = 1; var a;` and `{ const a = 1; var a; }` parse without any error, although `let a; var a;` is correctly rejected with "Identifier 'a' has already been declared". Trace how declared names are recorded and checked, find the root cause and fix it with a minimal change. Legal shadowing in nested scopes must keep working.
